literal: why · not · eat · minced meat porridge
natural: why don't they eat meat porridge?

meaning.en: A famous remark symbolising out-of-touch rulers or privileged people who cannot imagine the hardships of ordinary people.
meaning.zh: 比喻养尊处优、不了解民间疾苦的人。

equivalents: out of touch with the poor

examples.zh: 他说穷人买不起房就去贷款，简直是何不食肉糜。
examples.en: He told poor people who couldn't afford a home just to take out a loan; it was a real 'why don't they eat meat porridge?'

examples.zh: 官员不了解民情，说出何不食肉糜这样的话，引来一片批评。
examples.en: The official was out of touch and said something like 'let them eat meat porridge', drawing widespread criticism.

story.en: When told that the people were starving with no grain to eat, Emperor Hui of Jin asked: 'Why don't they eat meat porridge?' (何不食肉糜).
story.zh: 据载晋惠帝听说百姓饿死，说：“何不食肉糜？”

usage.en: Quoted to mock the remarks of the privileged. Often used as a punchline. Literary; 糜 is read mí.
usage.zh: 用来讽刺养尊处优者的言论，常作调侃。书面语；“糜”读 mí。

pinyin: cǐ shí wú shēng shèng yǒu shēng
literal: this · moment · no · sound · beats · have · sound
natural: at this moment silence is better than sound

meaning.en: Silence can say more than words; sometimes the unspoken moment is the most moving.
meaning.zh: 此刻没有声音，反而比有声音更动人，比喻沉默时蕴含的感情更深。

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上大家默默拥抱，此时无声胜有声。
examples.en: At the graduation ceremony everyone hugged in silence; silence said it all.

examples.zh: 母亲没说一句话，只是递来一碗热汤，此时无声胜有声。
examples.en: Mother said nothing and just handed over a bowl of hot soup; silence said more than words.

story.en: After the pipa player's music pauses, the poet writes: 'Another, hidden sorrow and regret arises; at this moment silence is better than sound' (别有幽愁暗恨生，此时无声胜有声).
story.zh: 白居易《琵琶行》写琵琶声暂歇：“别有幽愁暗恨生，此时无声胜有声。”

usage.en: Quoted for moving silences, in writing and speech. Literary; usually a whole clause.
usage.zh: 常引用来形容动人的沉默。书面语，多单独成句。

meaning.en: Said of a young person who is thought hopeless or unteachable; often a joking or exasperated reproach.
meaning.zh: 指年轻人不堪造就，常用作半开玩笑或无奈的责备。

equivalents: you can't teach this kid anything

examples.zh: 跟他讲了三遍还是出错，真是孺子不可教。
examples.en: I explained it three times and he still got it wrong; he really is a lost cause.

examples.zh: 别以为我说孺子不可教，我是希望你再努力一点。
examples.en: Don't think I'm calling you hopeless; I just want you to try harder.

usage.en: The opposite of 孺子可教. Often said with 也: 孺子不可教也, half in jest. Casual to literary.
usage.zh: 与“孺子可教”相反，常说“孺子不可教也”，多带戏谑。口语至书面。

meaning.en: Shorthand for helping an ungrateful person who later harms you, from the fable of a farmer who warms a frozen snake and is bitten by it.
meaning.zh: 指好心救助忘恩负义的人，反遭其害，出自农夫救冻蛇反被咬死的寓言。

equivalents: nurse a viper in one's bosom

examples.zh: 他资助的人反过来告了他，真像农夫与蛇的故事。
examples.en: The man he supported ended up suing him, just like the farmer and the snake.

examples.zh: 帮助这种人，岂不是农夫与蛇？
examples.en: Helping a person like that is just the farmer and the snake, isn't it?

story.en: In Aesop's fable a farmer picks up a snake frozen by the cold and warms it in his bosom; once revived, the snake bites him.
story.zh: 《伊索寓言》中，农夫把冻僵的蛇放在怀里取暖，蛇苏醒后咬死了农夫。

date.zh: 古希腊 · 前6世纪（传为伊索所作）
date.en: ancient Greece, 6th c. BC (attributed to Aesop)

usage.en: Borrowed from Aesop, used as a ready-made comparison. Often followed by 的故事. Neutral register; modern borrowed phrase.
usage.zh: 源自《伊索寓言》，常用作现成的比喻，后常接“的故事”。中性语体；外来的四字词语。

meaning.en: To quarrel or fight with each other, originally said of family members, especially a husband and wife or mother-in-law and daughter-in-law.
meaning.zh: 互相争吵、争斗，原指家人（尤其夫妻、婆媳）之间吵闹。

examples.zh: 夫妻俩为了琐事勃谿相向，邻居都听见了。
examples.en: The couple quarrelled over trifles, and the neighbours heard it all.

examples.zh: 兄弟二人因遗产勃谿相向，最后对簿公堂。
examples.en: The two brothers quarrelled over the inheritance and ended up in court.

story.en: Zhuangzi: 'If a room has no empty space, mother-in-law and daughter-in-law will quarrel' (室无空虚，则妇姑勃谿), a picture of people crowded together with no room to be at ease.
story.zh: 《庄子·外物》：“室无空虚，则妇姑勃谿。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Literary and rare; 谿 is read xī, 勃谿 bó xī. Predicate.
usage.zh: 书面语，较少用；“谿”读 xī，“勃谿”读 bó xī。作谓语。

natural: gather like clouds and answer the call

meaning.en: People gather in great numbers and respond to a call at once.
meaning.zh: 像云一样聚集起来，纷纷响应号召。

equivalents: respond to the call in great numbers

examples.zh: 倡议发出后，各地志愿者云集响应。
examples.en: After the appeal was issued, volunteers from all over the country rallied to it.

examples.zh: 起义的消息一传开，四方百姓云集响应。
examples.en: As soon as news of the uprising spread, people from all quarters rose in response.

usage.en: Describes mass response to a call, in news and history. Formal; predicate.
usage.zh: 形容群众广泛响应号召，多见于新闻和历史叙述。书面语，作谓语。

meaning.en: Faithless and cold in love; to abandon a partner who has loved one deeply.
meaning.zh: 在感情上背信弃义、薄情寡义，抛弃深爱自己的人。

examples.zh: 小说里的男主人公负心薄幸，辜负了痴情的女子。
examples.en: The male lead of the novel was a faithless man who betrayed a devoted woman.

examples.zh: 她看清了他负心薄幸的真面目。
examples.en: She saw him for the faithless, heartless man he was.

usage.en: Mostly used of men who abandon women, in literature and drama. Literary; attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 多用于抛弃痴情女子的男子，常见于文学和戏曲。书面语，作定语、谓语。

meaning.en: Describes a lively, radiant look, with eyes full of spirit and charm.
meaning.zh: 形容目光流转、神采飞扬、精神焕发的样子。

examples.zh: 舞台上的她顾盼神飞，光彩照人。
examples.en: On stage she was radiant, her eyes full of life.

examples.zh: 他谈起理想时顾盼神飞，像换了一个人。
examples.en: When he talked of his ideals his eyes lit up, as if he were someone else.

usage.en: Praise for lively eyes and bearing, in literary writing. Similar to 顾盼生姿 and 顾盼生辉 but stresses spirit. Predicate.
usage.zh: 称赞神采奕奕，多用于文学描写。与“顾盼生姿”“顾盼生辉”相近，侧重神采。作谓语。

literal: hold · regret · to the end of · heaven
natural: to bear a regret for ever

meaning.en: To carry a lasting regret that can never be made up, especially over the death of a loved one.
meaning.zh: 心怀遗憾直到生命终结，无法弥补，多指亲人去世的遗憾。

equivalents: carry the regret to one's grave
a regret that can never be mended

examples.zh: 没能见父亲最后一面，他抱恨终天。
examples.en: He never got to see his father one last time and carried that regret for ever.

examples.zh: 她为当年的任性抱恨终天。
examples.en: She bore lasting regret for her wilfulness back then.

usage.en: A solemn, literary phrase for irreparable regret. Close to 抱恨终身 but 终天 means 'until the end of time'. Predicate.
usage.zh: 庄重的书面语，形容无法挽回的遗憾。与“抱恨终身”相近，“终天”意为永远。作谓语。

pinyin: zuò ér yán bù rú qǐ ér xíng
literal: sit · and · talk · not as good as · rise · and · act
natural: talking while seated is not as good as getting up and acting

meaning.en: Talking about doing something is no match for actually doing it.
meaning.zh: 坐着空谈不如起身行动，强调行动比空谈重要。

examples.zh: 计划开了三次会还没落实，坐而言不如起而行。
examples.en: We've held three meetings on the plan without carrying it out; it's better to act than to talk.

examples.zh: 坐而言不如起而行，咱们明天就动手吧。
examples.en: Talk is cheap; let's start tomorrow.

usage.en: A motto in speeches and exhortations; also written 坐而言，不如起而行. Neutral to formal.
usage.zh: 常用于演讲、劝勉；也写作“坐而言，不如起而行”。中性偏书面。

natural: pile up good deeds until they become virtue

meaning.en: By accumulating good deeds one gradually builds up good character.
meaning.zh: 不断积累善行，逐渐养成高尚的品德。

examples.zh: 积善成德，小善做得多了，人品自然好。
examples.en: Little goods piled up become virtue; do enough small kindnesses and your character will be good.

examples.zh: 学校提倡积善成德，鼓励学生从小事做起。
examples.en: The school promotes building virtue through good deeds, encouraging students to start small.

story.en: Xunzi: 'When water gathers and forms a deep pool, dragons are born in it; when goodness is accumulated and becomes virtue, divine understanding comes of itself' (积水成渊，蛟龙生焉；积善成德，而神明自得).
story.zh: 《荀子·劝学》：“积土成山，风雨兴焉；积水成渊，蛟龙生焉；积善成德，而神明自得，圣心备焉。”

usage.en: A maxim about moral cultivation, in school mottos and essays. Formal; predicate.
usage.zh: 关于品德修养的格言，常见于校训和作文。书面语，作谓语。

synonyms: 勿以恶小而为之，勿以善小而不为

natural: report the good news but not the bad

meaning.en: To tell only the good news and hide the bad, whether to spare others worry or to look good.
meaning.zh: 只说好消息，不说坏消息，或为了不让人担心，或为了粉饰自己。

equivalents: only tell people the good news

examples.zh: 在外打工的儿子总是报喜不报忧，生怕父母担心。
examples.en: The son working away from home only ever shares good news, so as not to worry his parents.

examples.zh: 下属报喜不报忧，领导就很难了解真实情况。
examples.en: If subordinates only report good news, it is hard for the leadership to know the real situation.

usage.en: Can be affectionate (family) or critical (officials, workplaces). Casual; predicate.
usage.zh: 可含善意（亲人之间），也可作批评（官场、职场）。口语，作谓语。

meaning.en: Being in a place where you know nobody and don't know your way around.
meaning.zh: 对当地的人和环境都不熟悉。

equivalents: a stranger in a strange land
new to the place and know no one

examples.zh: 刚到这个城市，人生地不熟，处处得问路。
examples.en: I'd just arrived in the city, a stranger knowing no one, and had to ask the way everywhere.

examples.zh: 他人生地不熟，朋友帮了不少忙。
examples.en: He didn't know anyone or anything here, and his friends helped a great deal.

usage.en: Often an excuse or a reason for asking help. Casual; predicate or clause.
usage.zh: 常用作求助或解释的理由。口语，作谓语或分句。

meaning.en: To be without equal in one's own era.
meaning.zh: 在当时没有人能与之相比。

examples.zh: 他的书法独步一时，求字者络绎不绝。
examples.en: His calligraphy was unrivalled in his day, and people came in an endless stream to ask for it.

examples.zh: 这位歌手当年独步一时，唱片卖了几百万张。
examples.en: In her day this singer had no rival, and her records sold millions.

usage.en: Praise for a person's peak period; literary. Compare 独步天下, 'unrivalled in the world'.
usage.zh: 称赞某人在某一时期的成就无人可比。书面语。可与“独步天下”比较。

literal: forge · work up · make into · case
natural: to work up a case against someone

meaning.en: To build a false case against an innocent person by forced confessions and fabricated evidence.
meaning.zh: 用逼供、编造罪证等手段，把无罪的人陷成罪案。

examples.zh: 酷吏锻炼成狱，不知多少好人蒙冤。
examples.en: Cruel officials fabricated cases, and many good people were wrongly accused.

examples.zh: 他们锻炼成狱，想置政敌于死地。
examples.en: They worked up a case to destroy their political rival.

usage.en: Used of historical miscarriages of justice and abuse of power. Formal; predicate.
usage.zh: 多用于历史上的冤狱和滥用权力。书面语，作谓语。

natural: a gold tablet exempting from death

meaning.en: A guarantee of immunity from punishment; figuratively, something that protects you from consequences.
meaning.zh: 能免于惩罚的保证；比喻可以保护自己、不受追究的凭证。

examples.zh: 有领导撑腰，他以为拿到了免死金牌，什么都敢做。
examples.en: With a senior figure backing him he thought he held a get-out-of-jail-free card and dared to do anything.

examples.zh: 这次成绩好并不是免死金牌，下次还得努力。
examples.en: A good result this time is no free pass; you still have to work hard next time.

usage.en: Originally an imperial favour in old stories; now figurative and often ironic. Casual.
usage.zh: 原为古代故事中皇帝赐予的特权，现多用比喻，常含讽刺。口语。
